hunks.baseline: Where the blade force swept past, hot blood spurted as heads sprang into the air.
hunks.sol: Where the force swept past, hot blood spurted as heads shot into the air.

hunks.baseline: I stepped on the ogre’s body as it collapsed like a bundle of straw and sprang high into the air. The sunlight touching the back of my neck was warm.
hunks.sol: I planted a foot on the ogre’s body as it collapsed like a bundle of straw and sprang high into the air. The sunlight on the back of my neck was warm.

hunks.baseline: It was noon. The location was a wasteland without a single tree.
hunks.sol: It was noon, and we were in a wasteland without a single tree.

hunks.baseline: With the sun at my back, my shadow fell across the midst of the thousand or so monsters gathered below—even the spearhead in it slashing downward as I dove.
hunks.sol: With the sun at my back, my shadow fell across the thousand or so monsters gathered below. Even the spearhead slashing downward as I dove was etched within it.

hunks.baseline: The Flame Dragon’s Claw raked across the earth.
hunks.sol: The Flame Dragon’s Claw raked the earth.

hunks.baseline: The roar sounded as if the sky itself had split apart. The ground sank several meters, sending dirt and fragments of stone flying in every direction.
hunks.sol: A deafening roar split the sky. The ground caved in several meters, sending dirt and shards of stone flying in every direction.

hunks.baseline: A vortex of hot air that erupted at the center of the battlefield became a blade and swept through the monsters.
hunks.sol: A whirlwind of scorching air erupted from the center of the battlefield and swept through the monsters like a blade.

hunks.baseline: Through my dust-clouded vision, green blood poured down in rapid splatters as System notifications announced the monsters’ deaths.
hunks.sol: Through the haze of dust, green blood rained down in heavy drops as System notifications announced the monsters’ deaths.

hunks.baseline: I waved my hand lightly, scattering the dust cloud. The monsters staring at me with blank faces came into view.
hunks.sol: I waved a hand, scattering the dust cloud, and found the remaining monsters staring blankly at me.

hunks.baseline: Their eyes seemed to ask what the hell had just happened. I drew in a deep breath, then shouted with my internal energy behind my voice.
hunks.sol: Their eyes seemed to ask what the hell had just happened. I drew a deep breath and shouted, pouring internal energy into my voice.

hunks.baseline: With an earsplitting roar, more than a thousand Hunters who had rushed in by then descended on the monster army like a wave.
hunks.sol: An earsplitting roar erupted as more than a thousand Hunters surged in and crashed over the monster army like a wave.

hunks.baseline: Crack-crack-crack!
hunks.sol: Crunch!

hunks.baseline: The farming was over. Now it was time to harvest.
hunks.sol: The farming was done. Now it was time to harvest.

hunks.baseline: I headed toward the Twin-Headed Ogre that looked like the boss monster.
hunks.sol: I headed toward the Twin-Headed Ogre that appeared to be the boss monster.

hunks.baseline: I swear to heaven, I had not a shred of ulterior motive.
hunks.sol: I swore to heaven, I didn’t have the slightest ulterior motive.

hunks.baseline: Well, after thinking about it, I didn’t need to swear.
hunks.sol: Well, thinking it over, there was no need to swear.

hunks.baseline: “Insidious human. Your intention to claim the byproducts is painfully obvious. You didn’t conceal your greed even while slaughtering my legion!”
hunks.sol: “Insidious human. Your scheme to claim the byproducts is plain to see. You couldn’t hide your greed even while slaughtering my legion!”

hunks.baseline: “Shut up and do your job. Hurry up and start making your kind kill each other as undead.”
hunks.sol: “Shut up and do your job. Hurry up, raise them as undead, and get them killing each other.”

hunks.baseline: “I was going to do that anyway. Grow, my sea of skeletons… Huh?”
hunks.sol: “I was about to do that. Rise, my sea of skeletons… Huh?”

hunks.baseline: “Why isn’t my power working? Is this perhaps a bug?”
hunks.sol: “Why isn’t my power working? Could this be a bug?”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord, whose modernization was progressing by the day, spoke in a dejected voice.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord, growing more modern by the day, answered in a dejected voice.

hunks.baseline: “The farther inside I go, the stronger the Arch Lich’s control seems to become. Ah, a commander without a legion. Truly, I cannot contain my grief. At this rate, I might as well be dead!”
hunks.sol: “The deeper we go, the stronger the Arch Lich’s control seems to become. Ah, a commander without a legion! Truly, I cannot contain my grief. At this rate, I might as well be dead!”

hunks.baseline: What the hell did this guy think he was?
hunks.sol: What the hell did this bastard think he was?

hunks.baseline: I was tired of telling him that he was already dead. Sighing inwardly, I charged at the leader.
hunks.sol: I was tired of reminding him that he was already dead. With an inward sigh, I charged at the leader.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen shouted with a flushed face. We had seen this scene more than ten times by now, so Team Leader Choi and I had reached the point where we simply took it in stride.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen shouted, his face flushed. Team Leader Choi and I had seen this more than ten times by now, so we simply took it in stride.

hunks.baseline: And we had finished without a single death. It really was a victory worth commemorating. In a situation like this, acting calm would be stranger.
hunks.sol: We had done it without losing a single person, too. It really was a victory worth commemorating. Acting calm in a situation like this would have been stranger.

hunks.baseline: “Our casualties are only twenty-three seriously wounded and thirty lightly wounded. Ah, this is really…!”
hunks.sol: “Our only casualties are twenty-three seriously wounded and thirty lightly wounded. Ah, this is just…!”

hunks.baseline: “How can this happen every time?”
hunks.sol: “How do you manage this every time?”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi gave me a slightly incredulous look.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi gave me a mildly incredulous look.

hunks.baseline: “Why?”
hunks.sol: “What?”

hunks.baseline: “Usually, this is when people say something modest, like that they were lucky.”
hunks.sol: “Usually, this is where people say something modest, like how they were lucky.”

hunks.baseline: “Usually, yes. But it’s not that I’m lucky. I’m genuinely strong. What else can I do? Isn’t that right, Shen?”
hunks.sol: “Usually, yes. But I’m not lucky. I really am this strong, so what am I supposed to do? Right, Shen?”

hunks.baseline: “Good lad. You’re a fine specimen of flattery.”
hunks.sol: “Good lad. A shining example of flattery.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi shook his head as he watched us trade lines back and forth.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi shook his head as he watched us banter.

hunks.baseline: Somehow, that sounded vaguely insulting.
hunks.sol: Why did that sound vaguely insulting?

hunks.baseline: “Ah, yes. I contacted them before the battle began.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, right. I contacted them before the battle began.”

hunks.baseline: Contacting them meant that he had sent several Hunters under his command ahead of us.
hunks.sol: By *contacted*, he meant he had sent several Hunters under his command ahead as messengers.

hunks.baseline: In this day and age, sending messengers seemed ridiculous, but there was no choice. Magic had made communication and satellite surveillance impossible, so we either had to run ourselves or use vehicles.
hunks.sol: Sending messengers in this day and age sounded ridiculous, but we had no choice. Magic had made communications and satellite surveillance impossible, so our only options were to run ourselves or use vehicles.

hunks.baseline: “It’ll take a while.”
hunks.sol: “It’ll take them a while.”

hunks.baseline: “They were already following us, so it shouldn’t take too long.”
hunks.sol: “They were already following behind us, so it shouldn’t take too long.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re tired, but put up some tents and let the men rest. The battle ended quickly, but fighting drains you completely.”
hunks.sol: “They must be tired, but put up some tents and let the men rest. The battle ended quickly, but fighting still takes everything out of you.”

hunks.baseline: “Shouldn’t we take care of the large monsters ourselves? It might be difficult for headquarters to move otherwise…”
hunks.sol: “Shouldn’t we deal with the larger monsters ourselves? They might be difficult for headquarters to move…”

hunks.baseline: Headquarters referred to the military forces moving with us.
hunks.sol: Headquarters referred to the military forces traveling with us.

hunks.baseline: When Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces, myself included, defeated the monsters at the front, the military forces following behind would “clean up” the area and the monster corpses.
hunks.sol: The Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces, myself included, defeated the monsters at the front. The military forces following behind then “cleaned up” the area and the monster corpses.

hunks.baseline: The reason I called it cleaning was that the purpose wasn’t to collect the byproducts.
hunks.sol: I called it cleaning because their purpose wasn’t to collect the byproducts.

hunks.baseline: It was literally cleanup. The army assigned to my western front spent most of its time chopping up the dead monsters so they couldn’t be resurrected as undead, then transporting the remains to the rear.
hunks.sol: It was literally cleanup. The army assigned to my western front spent most of its time chopping up the dead monsters so they couldn’t rise again as undead, then transporting the remains to the rear.

hunks.baseline: “Hyung-nim.”
hunks.sol: “Um, hyung-nim.”

hunks.baseline: “I was too embarrassed to mention this before, but… it seems that some of the senior officers have been making various complaints.”
hunks.sol: “I was too embarrassed to mention this before, but… it seems some of the senior officers have been grumbling.”

hunks.baseline: “Complaints? What kind?”
hunks.sol: “Grumbling? About what?”

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen glanced at me and lowered his voice cautiously.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen watched my expression and cautiously lowered his voice.

hunks.baseline: “They’re… somewhat dissatisfied with the roles they’ve been assigned.”
hunks.sol: “They’re… somewhat dissatisfied with the role they’ve been assigned.”

hunks.baseline: What the hell was he talking about?
hunks.sol: What the hell was that supposed to mean?

hunks.baseline: It took me a while to understand Shao Shen’s words. After a heavy silence passed, I finally parted my lips, half expecting the worst.
hunks.sol: It took me a while to understand him. After a long, heavy silence, I finally asked the question I dreaded.

hunks.baseline: “Do they want to stop cleaning up monster corpses and earn some merit themselves?”
hunks.sol: “Do they want to stop clearing away monster corpses and earn some glory themselves? Is that it?”

hunks.baseline: The profanity came out on its own. Soldiers were dying every day on the other fronts, and these people were complaining that cleaning up monster corpses was boring.
hunks.sol: The profanity came out on its own. Soldiers were dying every day on the other fronts, and these assholes were complaining that they were sick of cleaning up monster corpses.

hunks.baseline: I wondered if that was really something he should say in front of nearly a thousand Chinese people. But Chinese and chinks were, strictly speaking, two entirely different races.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t sure that was something he should say in front of nearly a thousand Chinese people, but the Chinese and chinks were, strictly speaking, two entirely different races.

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen, the model Chinese man, had gone red with embarrassment.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen, a model representative of the good Chinese, had gone red with embarrassment.

hunks.baseline: “I-I’m sorry. But I understand that not all the officers are like that. Only some of them have those complaints.”
hunks.sol: “I-I’m sorry. But it isn’t all the officers. As far as I know, only some of them are dissatisfied.”

hunks.baseline: “Some of them, huh. I’m sure that’s the case. But there’s something I’m curious about…”
hunks.sol: “Only some, huh? I’m sure. But there’s one thing I’m curious about…”

hunks.baseline: “Does that include the guy coming over there?”
hunks.sol: “Does that include the man coming over there?”

hunks.baseline: In the distance, more than a hundred armored vehicles and tanks approached us, raising a cloud of dust.
hunks.sol: In the distance, more than a hundred armored vehicles and tanks approached, raising a cloud of dust.

hunks.baseline: The vehicle bounced up and down as it raced along the ruined road. Through the window of the military vehicle I was sitting in, I began to see ruined rice paddies and fields, along with collapsed houses scattered here and there.
hunks.sol: The vehicle bounced up and down as it sped along the ruined road. Through the window, I began to see ravaged rice paddies and fields, with collapsed houses scattered among them.

hunks.baseline: After the cleanup was finished, I—or rather, *we*—were heading toward a nearby small city.
hunks.sol: Once the cleanup was finished, I—or rather, *we*—set out for a nearby small city.

hunks.baseline: “Ha-ha! You’ve really worked hard, Teacher Jin!”
hunks.sol: “Ha-ha! You’ve truly worked hard, Teacher Jin!”

hunks.baseline: A belly that even a tightly fastened belt couldn’t conceal. A bald crown gleaming beneath the sun.
hunks.sol: A belly even a tightly cinched belt couldn’t hide. A bald crown gleaming beneath the sun.

hunks.baseline: If not for the military uniform he wore and the three stars on his shoulder strap, I would never have had any reason to meet the middle-aged man in front of me.
hunks.sol: If not for his military uniform and the three stars on his shoulder boards, I would never have had any reason to meet the middle-aged man sitting across from me.

hunks.baseline: “I contacted the higher-ups this morning, as it happens. The entire world, not to mention the United Nations Security Council, is in an uproar over Teacher Jin’s victory report! I don’t know what they mean, but apparently people in Korea are calling today Jumo’s death anniversary…[^1]
hunks.sol: “I managed to contact the higher-ups this morning. The whole world is in an uproar over the news of Teacher Jin’s victories, not just the United Nations Security Council! I’m not sure what it means, but apparently people in Korea are calling today Jumo’s death anniversary…”[^1]

hunks.baseline: [^1]: *Jumo* is a traditional tavern keeper. Koreans jokingly call for her to serve drinks online when celebrating a national triumph.”

hunks.baseline: I had reached my limit for listening to his nonstop stream of nonsense. Unable to hold back any longer, I cut in.
hunks.sol: I had reached my limit for his endless stream of nonsense. Unable to take any more, I cut in.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t care whether the tavern lady is dead or alive. Can I ask you one thing?”
hunks.sol: “I don’t care whether Jumo is dead or alive. Can I ask you one thing?”

hunks.baseline: Under China’s official military structure, this was the Chengdu Military Region. More specifically, the man before me was Senior General Liao, commander-in-chief of the Thirteenth Group Army, which included seven divisions and brigades.
hunks.sol: Under China’s official military structure, this was the Chengdu Military Region. More specifically, the man before me was Senior General Liao, commander-in-chief of the Thirteenth Group Army, which encompassed seven divisions and brigades.

hunks.baseline: He looked at me anxiously.
hunks.sol: He stared at me anxiously.

hunks.baseline: “Why, why are you acting like this? Did something happen?”
hunks.sol: “Wh-Why are you acting like this? Did something happen?”

hunks.baseline: “I heard something strange today, so I’m a little sensitive right now.”
hunks.sol: “I heard something strange today, so I’m a little on edge.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. What I wanted to ask is…”
hunks.sol: “Ah, yes. What I wanted to ask was…”

hunks.baseline: He had known about it and still done nothing. It was so absurd that I had passed beyond anger and reached a state of numbness.
hunks.sol: He had known and done nothing. It was so absurd that I had gone beyond anger and come out numb on the other side.

hunks.baseline: Still, he was technically an ally and a three-star general from another country, so I asked as calmly and politely as I could.
hunks.sol: Still, he was technically an ally and a three-star general from another country. I kept my tone as calm and polite as possible.

hunks.baseline: “What kind of lunatics are throwing a fit about wanting to earn merit at a time like this? To put it bluntly, they aren’t going to fight themselves. They’ll just put ordinary soldiers in front and wave their command batons from behind, won’t they?”
hunks.sol: “What kind of lunatics throw a fit about earning merit at a time like this? It’s not like they’ll be fighting themselves. They’ll put ordinary soldiers out front and wave their command batons from the rear, won’t they?”

hunks.baseline: “What the fuck does it mean that they’re tired of cleaning up monster corpses? What, have they seen so many of them that they’ve grown fond of them and want to become corpses themselves? They’ll have to actually die before they come to their senses. Goddamn it.”
hunks.sol: “What the fuck do they mean, they’re tired of cleaning up monster corpses? What, have they seen so many that they’ve grown fond of them and want to become corpses too? Do they need to actually die before they come to their senses? Fucking assholes.”

hunks.baseline: “If there are any of those bastards, tell them to come see me. I’ll equip them and put them in the vanguard. They’d make perfect meat shields—”
hunks.sol: “If there are any bastards like that, tell them to come see me. I’ll gear them up and put them in the vanguard. They’d make perfect meat shields—”

hunks.baseline: I suddenly shut my mouth.
hunks.sol: I abruptly fell silent.

hunks.baseline: I’d suspected he was no ordinary madman ever since he’d kicked up that whole goddamn fuss in an underground bunker over whether or not to launch a nuke. But he was clearly insane on an entirely different level.
hunks.sol: I’d suspected he was no ordinary madman ever since he’d raised that whole goddamn fuss in an underground bunker over whether or not to launch a nuke. Apparently, he was insane on an entirely different level.

hunks.baseline: “General, are you in your right mind?”
hunks.sol: “General, are you out of your mind?”

hunks.baseline: “Well, that is… We also have to show them something. We have to prove that we can do something too…”
hunks.sol: “Well, the thing is… We need to show them something too. We need to prove that we can accomplish something ourselves…”

hunks.baseline: “No casualties, everything moving forward smoothly—what more do you want to show them? The Hunters are breaking through the path ahead, while the army is cleaning up behind them and rescuing civilians. We’re doing a good job. What else do you want to show?”
hunks.sol: “We’re advancing smoothly without taking losses. What more do you need to show? The Hunters are clearing the way up front, while the army handles the aftermath and rescues civilians behind us. Everyone’s doing their job. What more is there to show?”

hunks.baseline: “Now, now! Let’s not speak informally to each other. Whether you consider my age or my rank, I’m not someone who should be treated this way by Teacher Jin.”
hunks.sol: “N-Now, now! Let’s not speak informally to each other. Considering both my age and my rank, I am not someone Teacher Jin should treat this way.”

hunks.baseline: “How about I crack your skull open with a serving bowl?”
hunks.sol: “How about I treat your skull to a serving bowl?”

hunks.baseline: “Nothing. You heard me wrong. Anyway, I understand. Don’t entertain any foolish ideas. From now on, let’s advance slowly, minimize casualties, and rescue civilians. Understood?”
hunks.sol: “Nothing. You misheard me. Anyway, I understand. Don’t get any foolish ideas. From now on, we advance slowly, minimize casualties, and rescue civilians. Understood?”

hunks.baseline: The moment I saw Senior General Liao’s eyes rolling around instead of answering, a chill ran down my spine.
hunks.sol: The moment I saw Senior General Liao’s eyes darting about instead of answering, a chill ran down my spine.

hunks.baseline: “Well, I’m currently involved in the military procurement corruption scandal too. It’s time for me to accomplish something independently…”
hunks.sol: “Well, I’m also implicated in a military procurement corruption case, and it’s time for me to accomplish something independently…”

hunks.baseline: My kick tore the armored door off its hinges. The driver sitting in the front seat hurriedly slammed on the brakes.
hunks.sol: My kick tore the armored door off its hinges. The driver in the front seat slammed on the brakes.

hunks.baseline: Senior General Liao huddled up and trembled as he answered in a stammering voice.
hunks.sol: Senior General Liao curled into himself, trembling as he stammered out an answer.

hunks.baseline: “I-I thought there might be monsters in the small city we’re heading toward, so I deployed some of the Public Security Armed Forces Hunters who had been held in reserve…”
hunks.sol: “I-I thought there might be monsters in the small city we’re heading toward, so I deployed some of the Public Security Armed Forces Hunters we were holding in reserve…”
I didn’t need to hear any more.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t need to hear any more. Before I could press him further, a roar rang out from the city that had suddenly drawn close.
hunks.sol: Before I could press him further, a roar erupted from the city now looming nearby.

[^1]: *Jumo* is a traditional tavern keeper. Koreans jokingly call for her to serve drinks online when celebrating a national triumph; calling it her death anniversary means the celebration has worked her to death.
